text: Si ɓee wennjooɓe fii wooɗindingol Alla ngol wi'anaama: "Jokkee wahayu mo Alla jippini on e Nulaaɗo Makko on", ɓe wi'ay: "Men jokkataa ɗum. Wurin ko ko men tawri baabiraaɓe amen ɓen kon, e rewugol sanamu, men jokka". E hara ɓe jokkay baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen, hay si tawii seytaane woniino noddiroowo ɓen e ko rewugol sanamuuji majjinayɗi ɓe, ɗi ɗowira e lepte Yiite dulɓoowe ngen Ñalnde Darngal?
